LESSON: BAPTISM OF JESUS JESUS CHRIST

Strand: The Early 3.2 Jesus Christ By the end of the Sub strand, the  Learners to read 
Topic 3.3: Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the person who baptized church leaders
2. acquire the value of humility for peaceful co-existence with others

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the person who baptized church leaders
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify the person who baptized church leaders. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. acquire the value of humility for peaceful co-existence with others
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to acquire the value of humility for peaceful co-existence with others. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ.
2. Explain Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ.
4. Show that you can: identify the person who baptized church leaders
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify the person who baptized church leaders
2. acquire the value of humility for peaceful co-existence with others

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
